description: Multiple handlers (mailbox.rs line ~209, identity.rs, thread.rs, vacation.rs) call serde_json::from_value(v.clone()) where v is a reference obtained from args.get(). The .clone() is avoidable when the value is only used once. Idiomatic approach: either restructure to use args.remove() (consuming the map entry) and call from_value(v) directly without cloning, or at minimum add a comment explaining why the clone is necessary. Several sites already do the right thing (submission.rs uses args.remove()), but the inconsistency signals the clone was habitual rather than necessary.
title: serde_json::from_value(v.clone()) should use serde_json::from_value(v) after move
